label: County rite
summary: Changes which rite a county has.
details: It runs on a county title. Vanilla mostly passes a rite saved in a scope or taken from another title, and sometimes a named rite such as `rite:theravada`.

label: Court language
summary: Sets the language spoken at the character's court.
details: Give it a language key, for example `language_norwegian`. Vanilla uses it once, with `language_latin`.

label: Court type
summary: Sets the type of the character's royal court.
details: Give it a court type key. Vanilla uses it once, with `court_nomadic`.

label: Cultural acceptance
summary: Sets the culture's cultural acceptance with the target culture, to an exact value.
details: It runs on a culture and sets the value outright rather than adding to it. Vanilla uses it with the liege's culture as the target and the value 50.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The culture whose acceptance is set.

fields.name: value
fields.values: a number or a script value

label: Culture
summary: Changes the character's culture to the given culture.
details: Vanilla gives it a named culture, a saved scope, or another character's culture.

label: Culture: involved
summary: Marks a culture as taking part in the struggle.
details: It runs on a struggle. Vanilla does not use it in the game's own script, so this rests on the game's documentation alone.

label: Culture: uninvolved
summary: Marks a culture as no longer taking part in the struggle.
details: It runs on a struggle. The game's own documentation text says "involved" here, which looks like a copy mistake; the key's name and the app's label point to the opposite. Vanilla uses it once, with `culture:aragonese`.

label: Culture name
summary: Gives a culture a new, fixed name.
details: The texts are worked out once and saved as plain text, so the name does not change later even if the things the text refers to disappear. Vanilla uses it twice, each time with all three parts and plain keys. What each part is used for is inferred from its name.

fields.name: noun
fields.text: The culture's name as a noun.
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: collective_noun
fields.text: The name for the culture's people as a group (going by the name).
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: prefix
fields.text: A name prefix (going by the name).
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

label: Culture pillar
summary: Gives a culture a pillar, replacing the pillar it has in the same slot.
details: A pillar is a core trait of a culture, such as an ethos, a language or a martial custom. Each culture has one per slot. Vanilla uses it with martial customs and languages.

label: Culture same as
summary: Gives the character the same culture as the target character.
details: The target character's culture is copied to the character it runs on. Vanilla uses it with `root`.

label: Court grandeur
summary: Sets the current court grandeur of a character who has a royal court.
details: The value is held between the game's lowest and highest allowed grandeur. It starts no grace period and removes any one that is running. Vanilla uses it with `court_grandeur_minimum_expected`.

label: De jure liege title
summary: Makes the given title the de jure liege of the title.
details: De jure means the title belongs there by right of the map, whoever actually holds it. It moves the title under the new one. Vanilla uses it very often, with named titles or saved titles.

label: Dead character variable
summary: Saves a variable on a dead character, for a limited time.
details: A duration is required.

fields.name: value
fields.values: a scope, `yes`/`no`, a number, a script value or a flag

fields.name: years
fields.values: a number of years (also `weeks` or `days`; the game's documentation shows a min and max pair)

label: Death reason
summary: Sets the killer, the cause and the artifact for how a dead character died.
details: All three parts are optional. It runs on a character who is already dead.

fields.name: artifact
fields.text: The artifact used in the death.

label: Default education
summary: Sets the character's default education focus.
details: Vanilla only ever writes `yes`.

label: Definitive form
summary: Turns the title's definitive form name on or off.
details: With it on, the name is used without "Kingdom of" in front. `no` clears it.

label: Delete on destroy
summary: Sets whether the title is removed from the game entirely once it is destroyed.
details: Vanilla only writes `yes`.

label: Designated heir
summary: Makes one of the character's own children their designated heir.
details: The target has to be a direct child. For a character who is not one, see the unsafe variant.

label: Designated heir (unsafe)
summary: Makes the target character the designated heir, without guarding against heir loops.
details: The game warns that this is unsafe if the designated heirs loop, so make sure there is none. It is meant for mod support, and the game says designers should never use it.

label: Designated winner
summary: Makes the target character the designated winner of the great holy war.
details: It runs on a great holy war. Vanilla gives it the claimant or the title recipient.

label: Destroy if no valid heir
summary: Sets whether the title is destroyed on succession when no heir fits its restrictions.
details: Vanilla only writes `yes`.

label: Destroy on same-tier gain
summary: Sets whether the title is deleted from the game when a character gains or creates another title of the same tier.
details: Vanilla writes `yes` in nearly all uses and `no` once.

label: Destroy on succession
summary: Sets whether the title is destroyed when it passes on by succession.
details: Vanilla only writes `yes`.

label: Diarch
summary: Makes the target character the new diarch of the character's diarchy.
details: A diarchy needs to be active, otherwise it has nothing to change. Vanilla gives it the new co-ruler or minister.

label: Diarchy mandate
summary: Sets the mandate of the diarch.
details: Give it a mandate type, for example `promote_might`. The documented example runs it on the diarch.

label: Diarchy swing
summary: Sets how the scales of power swing in the active diarchy.
details: The value is a number, for example 55. Vanilla uses numbers like 60 and 100, or a script value.

label: Diarchy type
summary: Sets the type of diarchy for the character.
details: Give it a diarchy type key, for example `regency`. Vanilla uses it once, with `co_emperorship`.

label: Disallow retreat
summary: Stops one side of a combat from retreating.
details: If that side loses, it takes heavy casualties. `no` undoes it, and `no` is the default.

label: Domicile culture
summary: Sets the culture of a domicile, if that kind of domicile has one.
details: Vanilla usually gives it the culture of a capital county, or the culture of another saved scope.

label: Domicile faith
summary: Sets the domicile's rite to the main rite of the given faith, if that kind of domicile has one.
details: Vanilla uses it once, with `faith:tengri_pagan`.

label: Domicile rite
summary: Sets the rite of a domicile, if that kind of domicile has one.
details: Vanilla usually gives it the rite of a capital county, or the rite of another saved scope.

label: Dynasty name
summary: Changes the name of the dynasty.
details: It takes a localization key or dynamic text. Vanilla uses keys, including a dynasty name key such as `dynn_d__Lyon`.

label: Employer
summary: Moves the character into the target character's court.
details: The character it runs on becomes a courtier of the target. Vanilla mostly gives it `root` or a saved character.

label: Outbreak intensity
summary: Sets how severe an epidemic outbreak is.
details: The values are `minor`, `major` and `apocalyptic`.

label: Ethnicity
summary: Sets the character's ethnicity.
details: If it belongs to a different portrait group and the character has DNA, the DNA is randomized.

label: Ethos from
summary: Gives the culture the same ethos as the target culture.
details: The ethos is one of a culture's pillars. Vanilla uses it with a saved founder culture.

label: Faith: involved
summary: Marks a faith as taking part in the struggle.
details: It runs on a struggle. Vanilla gives it the faith of a rite.

label: Faith: uninvolved
summary: Marks a faith as no longer taking part in the struggle.
details: It runs on a struggle.

label: Faith name
summary: Changes the name, description and follower names of an existing faith.
details: Each part takes a localization key or dynamic text.

fields.name: name
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: desc
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: adjective
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: adherent
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

fields.name: adherent_plural
fields.values: a localization key or dynamic text

label: Fallback heir
summary: Sets a character who inherits when the normal succession finds nobody.
details: It only matters when the normal succession returns no line of heirs.
